integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducibility code provided; exact finite enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite certificate. Publication-priority uncertainty remains and no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed points only; complete unweighted bipartite graphs; nonnegative integer closed-neighborhood thresholds; some constructions use threshold-zero constant local maps; other graph classes, dynamics and convergence are not addressed.
